linked_process_id.description: Linked process identifier from upstream workflow (do not modify)

timestamp.description: Time when results were committed to the database

summary.description: Summary metrics from AKTA peak analysis

n_peaks.description: Number of detected peaks in UV 280 nm trace

first_peak_retention_min.description: Retention time of the first detected peak (min)

max_peak_height_mau.description: Maximum peak height in UV 280 nm trace (mAU)

index.description: Index of peak in time array

data_files.description: Output data file paths from analysis script

chromatogram_csv.description: Path to processed chromatogram CSV file

peaks_csv.description: Path to peaks table CSV file (if peaks detected)

analysis_results_json.description: Path to full analysis results JSON file

files_processed.description: Number of files processed by analysis script

raw_analysis.description: Raw analysis results object as produced by analysis script
